article.title: Consolidation of claims.
article.content:
38Consolidation of claims.

38. [Consolidation of claims.] Omitted by the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Amendment) Act, 2026 (6 of 2026), s. 25 (w.e.f. 26-05-2026).
